description: Knowledge Matrix for The Things I Let Him See, Book 1. Tracks what each character knows (or does not know) at key milestones across the 18-chapter arc. Milestones are derived from total_chapters=18: ~2% = 1, 20% = 4, 50% = 9, 72% = 13, 100% = 18.

Calder Reed.ch1: Knows: Grant hired him for 21-day surveillance; Lena is his target; Grant claims Lena is unstable; he has common-area camera access and the courtyard apartment; he retains unedited originals. Does not know: Lena will detect him; Grant's manipulation is manufactured; Lena controls what he sees.
Calder Reed.ch4: Knows: Lena has repeated routines; she sometimes looks toward his window; Grant messages her after her courtyard appearances; displaced objects and missing mail are reported. Does not know: Lena detected the camera light in Ch3; she is testing him; the routines are diagnostic.
Calder Reed.ch9: Knows: Lena detected him in Ch3; she knows his surname 'Reed'; she knows Grant hired him; she knows he keeps originals; she confronted him in the laundry room; they formed an alliance under her explicit rules; Grant entered her apartment in Ch7. Does not know: the full extent of her controlled visibility; the honeytoken strategy; the door-seal planner; the red-receipt timeline.
Calder Reed.ch13: Knows: Lena mailed a certified envelope in Ch8; Grant repeated the phrase 'Friday key return' in Ch12, proving mail interception; Mae printed the access audit; the evidence is building. Does not know: the full planner and red-receipt system; that Lena controlled the decisive sequence of visible events; the exact contents of the envelope.
Calder Reed.ch18: Knows: Lena designed the entire evidence trap; she controlled what he saw from Ch3 onward; the honeytoken, planner, receipts, and seals were all her design; Grant's false chain was exposed; the evidence is in official custody; Lena asks him to return without recording equipment. Hidden truth: He was the watched, not the watcher; his attraction was engineered by her controlled visibility; she chooses him only after all dependencies end.

Lena Hart.ch1: Knows: Grant is manipulating her environment (displaced objects, missing mail, deleted footage, timed messages); she is being watched from across the courtyard; she does not know the observer's identity, loyalty, or recording method. Does not know: Calder's name; that he keeps originals; the full scope of Grant's admin access.
Lena Hart.ch4: Knows: The observer is a man named 'Reed' (from lobby package label); the surveillance started near the settlement date; Grant hired him; she has begun diagnostic tests (red receipts, door seals, paper planner, repeated routines). Does not know: Calder keeps unedited originals; Grant's full manipulation timeline (7 weeks); the observer's archive policy.
Lena Hart.ch9: Knows: Calder is Grant's contracted operative; he keeps unedited originals; he witnessed Grant's Ch7 entry; he will preserve evidence under her explicit rules; she confronted him and formed an alliance. Does not know: the full extent of Calder's archive (he recorded the envelope removal); the exact contents of the envelope footage; whether Calder will obey her rules.
Lena Hart.ch13: Knows: The honeytoken worked (Grant repeated 'Friday key return'); Mae printed the access audit; the evidence is building; Calder transferred a duplicate to Cross. Does not know: Calder's full internal arc (his desire for possession vs. preservation); whether he will override her plan at the climax.
Lena Hart.ch18: Knows: Grant's manipulation is fully exposed; the evidence is in official custody; she retains possession of the apartment; Calder obeyed her withdrawal of consent in Ch16; he returned without recording equipment; she chooses him only after all dependencies end. Hidden truth: She controlled the decisive sequence of visible events from Ch3 onward; Calder was never the watcher.

Grant Hart.ch1: Knows: Calder accepted the contract; Calder can observe Lena's courtyard-facing rooms; Lena is noticing displaced objects and missing mail; Mae expressed uncertainty; reports support instability; the deadline nears. Does not know: Calder keeps unedited originals; Lena detected the surveillance; the full scope of Lena's counterstrategy.
Grant Hart.ch4: Knows: Calder still submits usable reports; Lena remains; she may be packing; Mae supports her; his manipulation is ongoing. Does not know: Lena's detection; the red-receipt system; the door-seal planner; Calder's independent archive.
Grant Hart.ch9: Knows: Calder still submits reports; Lena remains; Calder refuses to enter the apartment; the envelope holds a false checklist and 'Friday key return' phrase. Does not know: Calder's recording of the Ch7 entry; the recording of the envelope removal; the honeytoken purpose; Lena's copy of the checklist; the Ch9 alliance; the consent rules.
Grant Hart.ch13: Knows: Mae accessed the terminal; Calder's reports are thinner; Lena remains; Calder will attend the session; he holds the envelope and false checklist; the edited dashboard no longer shows his entries. Does not know: what Mae printed; where the audit is hidden; the terminal verification code; the evidence index delivered to Cross; the encrypted duplicate; Lena's plan to make him state a false chain of custody.
Grant Hart.ch18: Knows: He authenticated the envelope at the settlement; he asserted a false recycling-area chain of custody; Calder's unedited footage contradicted him; the evidence is in official custody; he lost admin access; the condo is under audit. Hidden truth: He never knew Calder kept originals; he never knew Lena controlled the visible sequence; he was outmaneuvered by both.

Mae Torres.ch1: Knows: Lena may be stressed; Grant's systems appear accurate; she trusts Grant's board role. Does not know: Grant is altering both Lena's environment and the digital record; Calder's independent archive; the full extent of the manipulation.
Mae Torres.ch4: Knows: Lena seems more organized than Grant claims; she notices small inconsistencies but cannot confirm them. Does not know: the manipulation is manufactured; Calder's role; the surveillance.
Mae Torres.ch9: Knows: Lena is being watched; Calder is involved; something is wrong with Grant's systems. Does not know: the full scope of the manipulation; the honeytoken; the access audit exists.
Mae Torres.ch13: Knows: She printed the local credential audit from the board terminal; Grant's master credential was used during deleted intervals; the audit is hidden in a cookbook. Does not know: the full evidence chain; the honeytoken details; Calder's archive.
Mae Torres.ch18: Knows: The audit corroborated Grant's pattern; the evidence is in official custody; Lena retained the apartment; she gives Lena a sealed archived complaint from another condominium. Hidden truth: The complaint predates Grant's board position and describes short camera gaps paired with resident instability reports.

Imani Cross.ch1: Knows: Nothing about the case. She is not yet involved.
Imani Cross.ch13: Knows: Calder has contacted her about potential evidence; she has not yet seen the material. Does not know: the full scope of the evidence; the identities involved; the legal implications.
Imani Cross.ch18: Knows: She holds one encrypted duplicate of the original surveillance archive; the evidence index; the access audit; the contract; the field notebook; the honeytoken footage; she must verify before further action; offenses include unlawful entry, mail interference, digital evidence tampering, coercive surveillance, attempted fraud, false documentary representations. Hidden truth: She refuses to treat one accusation as sufficient; she requires independent verification.
